description: Search jobs immediately from role, country, location and optional stated experience. No resume required. Newest first; automatically widens 7, 14, 30 days then all dates until 5 matches. For another page reuse the same filters and returned window.daysUsed as maxAgeDays, with pagination.nextOffset. Resume-based ranking is optional via recommend_jobs.

country.description: Two-letter country code for job eligibility, such as IN or DE

experienceYears.description: Years of experience to compare with the posting's stated min/max range; not a qualification or fit verdict.

includeUnknownExperience.description: With experienceYears, also keep roles without a stated range, clearly unknown rather than matched.

limit.description: How many jobs to return in this page

maxAgeDays.description: Omit to widen 7/14/30/all until 5 matches. Explicit positive values exclude undated roles; 0 includes all dates.

offset.description: Where the page starts. Use pagination.nextOffset from the previous result rather than counting by hand

query.description: Words to match in job title or company

remote.description: True for remote-only; false for non-remote-only

name: search_jobs

guidance.description: How to present these results honestly; meant for the assistant, not the candidate

age.description: Bucketed posting age; undated means the board gave no date, not that the role is fresh

eligibleCountries.description: Two-letter codes the role is open to

experience.description: Years the posting itself states as { min, max }; null when it states none, absent when the description was not read

id.description: Stable id to pass to get_job, analyze_job_fit or optimize_resume

updatedAt.description: When the board says the role was posted or last updated; absent when the board states none

url.description: The employer's own posting, which is where an application is made

pagination.description: offset, limit, total and nextOffset. nextOffset is null on the last page

window.description: The age window the results came from, and whether it had to widen. Say which window was used

title: Search jobs
